items.titleEn: Generation Identity is still cheering for the prime minister's election

items.title: Spekulationer om Trumps påvirkning af markedet er blusset op
items.summary: Ad flere omgange er der blevet spekuleret i, om Donald Trump bruger præsidentembedet til at gavne sine egne investeringer. Sagen med Nvidia-chefen Jensen Huang har antændt spekulationerne på ny.
items.titleEn: Speculation about Trump's impact on the market has been extinguished.
items.summaryEn: On several occasions, there has been speculation as to whether Donald Trump is using his presidency to benefit his own investments. The case with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has reignited speculation.

items.titleEn: There's a new home for veterans coming to Vordingborg.
items.summaryEn: The conditions for Danish veterans need to be strengthened, and therefore an agreement has been reached to build another veterans' home.

items.title: Nationalmuseet i krise: Rane Willerslev deler fyresedler ud igen
items.summary: Nationalmuseet er i krise og gennemfører nu den anden store fyringsrunde i år. Dårlig økonomi og svigtende publikum gør det ifølge museet nødvendigt at skære i medarbejderstaben.
items.titleEn: The National Museum in Crisis: Rane Willerslev distributes fireplaces again
items.summaryEn: The National Museum is in crisis and is now conducting the second major fireworks round this year. Poor finances and a failing public make it necessary, the museum says, to cut staff.

items.title: Fem rumænere fængslet for at stjæle vin på restauranter
items.summary: De fem mænd blev anholdt onsdag og er sigtet for indbrud på tre restauranter, hvor der blev stjålet dyr vin.
items.titleEn: Five Romanians jailed for stealing wine from restaurants
items.summaryEn: The five men were arrested on Wednesday and charged with three counts of burglary and theft of live-in wine.

items.title: Stormløbet mod Ceuta blev dråben. Nu vil spanierne have grænseporten smækket i
items.summary: Spaniens »slapperpolitik« har længe vakt irritation. Nu er en udlændingedebat med årtiers forsinkelse blusset op i EUs mest migrantvenlige land, hvor de borgerlige favoritter ved søndagens valg vil skrue bissen på.
items.titleEn: The storm rush to Ceuta was the drop. Now the Spaniards will have the border gate slammed in.
items.summaryEn: Spain's policy of slapping has long been a source of irritation. Now a decades-long debate on immigration has been put to rest in the EU's most migrant-friendly countries, where the bourgeois favourites in Sunday's elections will bite the bullet.

items.title: Højt over Arktis er der sket noget historisk – og det kan få en kuldegysende konsekvens herhjemme
items.summary: For få uger siden opstod en historisk begivenhed højt over Arktis, og den har allerede medvirket til at sende kulde ned over os. En intens kamp om vinteren er indledt i de højere luftlag. Hvem vinder kuldeslaget?
items.titleEn: High above the Arctic, something historic has happened and it could have a chilling effect here at home.
items.summaryEn: A few weeks ago, a historic event occurred high above the Arctic, and it has already contributed to sending cold down on us. An intense winter battle has begun in the higher air forces. Who's gonna win the shot?

items.title: Han er ung og utilfreds med det nye Fadervor: Moderniseringen rejser to vigtige spørgsmål
items.summary: Fadervor fortjener efter min mening at blive behandlet med den respekt, som dets betydning kalder på, skriver Jonathan Rasmussen, der læser religion og snart også teologi.
items.titleEn: He is young and dissatisfied with the new Fatherhood: Modernisation raises two important questions
items.summaryEn: I think our fathers deserve to be treated with the respect that their significance calls for", writes Jonathan Rasmussen, who studies religion and soon also theology.
